slides.sub: In GTA 6? Here's how to turn Leonida into a complete disaster zone.

slides.head: WHERE TO GO
slides.body: Fenced-off compound on the north side of Lake Leonida. No marker. Just warning signs everywhere.

slides.head: PUSH THE CONTAINER
slides.body: Go around the east side. Use the bulldozer to push the container over. Under it: a secret underground tunnel.

slides.head: MINES + DRONES
slides.body: The tunnel leads toward the bunker. This area is littered with mines and drones. Go careful.

slides.head: FREDDIE SENDS YOU AWAY
slides.body: Try to open the bunker door. A man called Freddie tells you to come back later. He will upgrade his traps.

slides.head: WAIT FOR HIS TEXT
slides.body: Then come back. This time jump in from the water tower in the north-east corner. Beat his defences again and he lets you in.

slides.head: INSIDE THE BUNKER
slides.body: Freddie pours you a drink and even has you on his podcast. Then a hurricane alert appears on the TV.

slides.head: LEAVE THE BUNKER
slides.body: When you get the option, leave. Outside, a hurricane is surrounding the whole map.

slides.head: HURRICANE UNLOCKED
slides.body: Insane wind, insane rain, heavy fog, everything grey. Roads are slippery. After this you permanently unlock crazier weather.

slides.h2: FLOOD LEONIDA OR KEEP IT SUNNY?
slides.sub: Save this for later and send it to the friend who'd flood the whole map.
